description: This file implements the WindowManagerHandler class and its nested WindowManagerNotification class, which manage interactions with a window manager component, including initialization, event handling, and rendering control.

classes.name: WindowManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles window manager interactions, including registration, event notifications, and rendering control.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class that handles specific window manager events such as user inactivity, disconnection, and readiness notifications.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::~WindowManagerHandler
methods.description: Destructor that logs the deletion of the instance.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager interface and registers for notifications.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::terminate
methods.description: Unregisters from window manager notifications and releases resources.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::onEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events and forwards them to the event handler.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::renderReady
methods.description: Checks if the app instance is ready for rendering.

methods.name: WindowManagerHandler::enableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables display rendering for a specific app instance.

methods.name: WindowManagerNotification::OnUserInactivity
methods.description: Handles user inactivity events and triggers onEvent.

methods.name: WindowManagerNotification::OnDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection events and triggers onEvent.

methods.name: WindowManagerNotification::OnReady
methods.description: Handles readiness events and triggers onEvent.
